s: One of the most significant differences with Ekster compared to other brands is their dedication to sustainability. As I feel this wallet in my hand right now, I honestly can’t tell that it isn’t regular leather. It’s a nice little bonus when you buy into companies like these, especially when they are on a journey to becoming completely climate neutral.
